description: Create a new CDSS (Kafka) cluster on 3rd-generation KVM servers (G3). ⚠️ Broker node parameters are named dataNode* here, not brokerNode* as in the G2 tool. VPC and subnets must be given by BOTH name and number. Use dryRun=true to preview.

clusterName.description: Cluster name (3-15 chars: lowercase letters, numbers, '-')

dataNodeStorageInfraResourceDetailTypeCo.description: Broker storage detail type. Documented valid value: CB1

dataNodeStorageSize.description: Broker node storage in GB (100-2000, 10GB increments)

dataNodeStorageType2Code.description: Broker storage type. The spec table says NET; the spec page's own sample sends SSD — unresolved, so it is passed through as given

dataNodeSubnetName.description: Broker node subnet name — required in addition to the number

generationCode.description: Server generation code. G3 for 3rd generation

kafkaManagerUserName.description: CMAK access account ID (still required by the API; CMAK itself is being phased out by Ncloud)

kafkaManagerUserPassword.description: CMAK access account password (still required by the API; CMAK itself is being phased out by Ncloud)

managerNodeSubnetName.description: Manager node subnet name — required in addition to the number

serverSpecCode.description: Server spec code (from ncloud_cdss_get_server_spec_list, e.g. cdss.s2-g3)

vpcName.description: VPC name — required in addition to vpcNo

name: ncloud_cdss_create_cluster_g3
